title: Expense Reimbursement Policy — Sales Division
content: Sales Division employees at Acme Corp may submit expense claims for client entertainment up to $300 per event. This higher limit reflects the revenue-generating nature of sales activities. All claims must be approved by the Sales Manager before submission. Software subscriptions required for CRM or sales tooling are reimbursable up to $100 per month per employee. Home office supplies are reimbursable up to $30 per quarter. Expenses exceeding these limits require VP of Sales approval. Reimbursements are processed within 15 business days of a complete submission.
